name: Atlas's Hoard
purpose: Shared local filesystem: projects contain shared live files and native folders for each Hoard. All project members open the same actual file paths. Tracks revisions and reusable derived results without rewriting originals.
notes: Local-only. Native tools save/open the same shared file paths. Atlas never automatically moves existing projects. API membership is cooperative and does not impose OS filesystem ACLs. A reusable result needs exact source hashes and a recipe including model revision when applicable.
